tournament.name: South America Magic Series - Regional Championship

decks.notes: The main idea of the deck is to aggressively sacrifice creatures to generate value and deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Witch's Oven, Mayhem Devil, and Bloodtithe Harvester, the deck aims to create a synergistic strategy that puts pressure on the opponent while also gaining incremental advantages through sacrificing creatures. The inclusion of cards like Jegantha, the Wellspring and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger adds additional versatility to the deck, allowing for different ways to close out the game or disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on using ramp cards like Lotus Cobra and Omnath to quickly gain mana advantage while maintaining control of the game with various spells and creatures. The key strategy is to accelerate mana production and consistently play powerful threats like Elesh Norn and Omnath, Locus of Creation to overwhelm the opponent. By combining ramp and control elements, this deck seeks to establish board dominance and outvalue the opponent to secure victory in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 matchup.

The deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of control spells and big threats like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Agent of Treachery, the deck aims to control the board and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The inclusion of Fires of Invention allows for explosive turns, while Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also runs a companion, Keruga, the Macrosage, to provide additional card advantage.

The strategy of this deck revolves around sacrificing creatures to generate value and deal damage to the opponent. Using cards like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Witch's Oven, the deck aims to control the board while also draining the opponent's life total. Additionally, cards like Kroxa and Claim the Firstborn provide disruption and allow for stealing key creatures from the opponent. This deck is designed to constantly apply pressure and force the opponent to react to its threats, ultimately leading to a quick victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to generate powerful combos by sacrificing low-cost artifacts to bring out high-cost threats like Torrential Gearhulk and Mirrex. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker helps enable this strategy by creating additional artifacts. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Negate and Divide by Zero to protect the combo pieces. The mana base is designed to support both the red and blue spells in the deck, with lands like Steam Vents and Shivan Reef providing the necessary colors. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in its approach to generating powerful game-winning plays.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the game through various counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Torrential Gearhulk. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while also generating card advantage and digging for key cards with spells like Memory Deluge and Dig Through Time. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and enchantments like Shark Typhoon provide additional value and win conditions, while the land base ensures consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The main idea of this deck is to aggressively sacrifice creatures for value, triggering effects like Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester to deal damage to the opponent. Utilizing cards like Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Claim the Firstborn allows for efficient sacrifice synergy while disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion that can provide additional mana acceleration and value. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with consistent pressure and disruption, ultimately leading to victory through sacrifice tactics.

This control deck focuses on using counterspells and removal spells to control the board and disrupt your opponent's game plan. It also includes card draw and search effects to help find the right answers when needed. The deck aims to stabilize the board with sweepers like Supreme Verdict and create card advantage with cards like Memory Deluge and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The inclusion of a companion like Kaheera, the Orphanguard adds an extra layer of synergy and consistency to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through careful resource management and controlled plays.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and cheap, efficient cards to quickly build up the board and overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced onslaught. With a mixture of low-cost creatures, efficient removal spells, and token generators, this deck aims to establish a strong presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game. By utilizing cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Venerated Loxodon to pump up creatures and push for damage, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures with varying effects to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It leverages the companion Keruga, the Macrosage for card advantage and includes a mix of high-impact creatures like Koma, Cosmos Serpent and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The deck also utilizes Leyline Binding and Temporary Lockdown to maintain control over the game state while Fires of Invention allows for explosive plays. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility in casting the deck's powerful spells.

The core strategy of this deck revolves around utilizing the combination of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to generate a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruption elements such as Thoughtseize and Witherbloom Command to hinder the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Scrapwork Mutt, Raffine's Informant, and Grisly Salvage helps to set up the combo pieces efficiently. Additionally, the deck incorporates versatile cards like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship to provide additional value and threats on the battlefield.

The deck revolves around a fast and aggressive strategy, utilizing powerful creatures and disruptive spells to quickly pressure the opponent and control the board. It includes a mix of efficient removal spells, hand disruption, and threats that can quickly close out the game. The deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with a relentless onslaught of damage. With a strong mana base and a diverse range of threats and answers, the deck is well-equipped to handle a variety of matchups in the Pioneer format.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, dealing damage to the opponent while constantly generating incremental advantages through synergy with cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while also steadily chipping away at their life total with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The inclusion of Jegantha as the companion allows for additional flexibility and consistency in the deck's mana base. Overall, this deck's key concept revolves around efficient creature sacrifice synergies and proactive aggression.

The deck focuses on using sacrifice mechanics with cards like Witch's Oven and Mayhem Devil to control the board while dealing direct damage to the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds another layer of consistency to the deck. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn, along with disruption tools like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while maintaining a strong board presence. Overall, the deck emphasizes aggression and resource management to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, using cards like Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven to generate incremental advantage. Mayhem Devil and Fatal Push provide additional removal and reach to close out games quickly. The main goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful sacrifice effects, while disrupting their game plan with Thoughtseize and Claim the Firstborn. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides an additional source of mana and flexibility to help ensure a smooth curve of threats.

The main focus of this Weenie White Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with small, efficient creatures and disrupt their game plan with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben. By playing aggressively and curving out with cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent. Additionally, protection spells like Brave the Elements and Ossification help to keep key creatures alive and ensure a steady stream of damage. The inclusion of Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire and Castle Ardenvale provide additional utility and resilience to the deck.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, backed up by burn spells and removal. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Bonecrusher Giant, and Soul-Scar Mage, along with efficient spells like Play with Fire and Showdown of the Skalds, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides an additional source of mana that can help maintain the deck's aggressive tempo.

The main idea of this Boros Aggro deck is to flood the board with low-cost creatures and use them as quickly as possible to overwhelm the opponent, while also using spells like Resolute Reinforcements and Reckless Bushwhacker to buff the team and deal a lot of damage. The addition of Jegantha as a companion allows for even more utility. The deck focuses on aggressive plays and quick victories, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to keep up the pressure and maintain board presence.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Torrential Gearhulk and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, in order to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and unexpected game-winning play. It also includes versatile spells like Magma Opus and Divide by Zero for card advantage and disruption, as well as flexible removal like Spikefield Hazard and Prismari Command. The deck aims to be proactive and adaptable, using a combination of creatures and spells to control the board and pressure the opponent for a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to achieve a high devotion to green mana in order to power up cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Polukranos Reborn. By ramping with cards like Llanowar Elves and Wolfwillow Haven, the deck aims to quickly cast its big threats like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provides card advantage and additional ramp. The deck also utilizes Cityscape Leveler and Karn, the Great Creator for versatility and disruption, making it a powerful aggro deck with a focus on green devotion.

This Dimir Aggro deck focuses on utilizing evasive creatures like Faerie Mastermind and Soaring Thought-Thief to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. It also disrupts opponents' strategies with cards like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch, while also providing some late-game power with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Nighthawk Scavenger. The deck aims to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy while also having some control elements to deal with opposing threats.

This Dimir Aggro deck focuses on quickly building up the board with evasive creatures like Thieves' Guild Enforcer and Merfolk Windrobber, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch. The deck can quickly close out games with cards like Soaring Thought-Thief and Nighthawk Scavenger, while also having some removal options like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. The deck also has some card advantage with Into the Story and Jace, the Perfected Mind, as well as some powerful late-game threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with spells in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix and other powerful creatures. By utilizing cheap spells like Opt, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe, as well as draw cards like Consider and Treasure Cruise, you can quickly cycle through your deck and bring out multiple Phoenixes in one turn. This aggressive playstyle is further enhanced by the ability to cast spells for free with Demilich and Arcane Proxy, putting pressure on your opponent early in the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field as a key piece in a combo strategy. The goal is to ramp up quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Vizier of Tumbling Sands, while also controlling the board with counter spells like Tale's End. The deck aims to dig through the library efficiently with cards like Impulse and Pore Over the Pages to find combo pieces like Emergent Ultimatum and Peer into the Abyss for a powerful win condition. With the right sequencing and card choices, this deck can execute its combo quickly and overwhelm the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. It utilizes powerful cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to apply pressure, while also using disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional threats that can quickly end the game if left unchecked. The deck also includes utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to ensure consistent mana access and card advantage.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay by sacrificing creatures for value and dealing incremental damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar to trigger abilities when creatures are sacrificed, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana fixing and utility. The deck aims to control the board and pressure the opponent with efficient threats, utilizing sacrifice synergies and removal spells to gain incremental advantage and close out games quickly.

The deck focuses on using sacrifice synergies to control the board and deal incremental damage to the opponent while generating value. Key cards like Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester work well with cards like Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven to create a strong engine. The goal is to outvalue the opponent through a combination of sacrificing creatures, disrupting their hand with Thoughtseize, and utilizing a variety of sacrifice effects to gain an advantage. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility to the deck.

The deck focuses on sacrificing creatures and generating value from their deaths using cards like Mayhem Devil and Witch's Oven. It also utilizes cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan while claiming control of their creatures with Claim the Firstborn. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to provide additional mana resources. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through a combination of sacrifice synergies and disruption, ultimately overwhelming them with a relentless stream of threats and removal.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost flying Spirit creatures to quickly apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal. The goal is to tempo out opponents by efficiently trading threats and answers, while maintaining card advantage with Curious Obsession. The deck is built around evasive creatures and disruptive spells to keep opponents on the back foot and unable to stabilize, ultimately securing victory through overwhelming aggression and control.

This deck focuses on playing evasive Spirit creatures and using tempo spells to control the game while maintaining card advantage with cards like Curious Obsession. By playing aggressively and utilizing counterspells and removal, this deck looks to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure the win through chip damage and efficient creature beats. The key strategy lies in leveraging the synergy between the Spirit creatures and their abilities, along with protecting and enhancing them with cards like Spell Queller and Supreme Phantom. The mana base is optimized to support the tempo-driven game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a continuous stream of low-cost creatures, supported by cards that enhance their abilities and protect them from removal. The focus is on quickly building a wide board presence and utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to boost the overall power of the army. The inclusion of Brave the Elements and Ossification provides protection and additional ways to outmaneuver the opponent's strategies. This deck aims to be fast-paced and aggressive, pressuring the opponent and maintaining control on the battlefield.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient creatures (aggro) that benefit from each other through synergy. The strategy focuses on quickly building a board presence with cheap creatures like Hopeful Initiate and Thalia's Lieutenant, while also providing protection and support with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Brave the Elements. The presence of cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Recruitment Officer helps maintain pressure on the opponent, while utility cards like Ossification offer additional versatility. The land base is designed to support the aggressive nature of the deck.
